title: Eleven Years and One Table
subtitle: 人际关系与伴侣 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际关系与伴侣（社会服务与人际沟通·家庭与人际）
meta: 主题语境：人际关系与伴侣（社会服务与人际沟通·家庭与人际）　|　核心词汇：couple　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 couple 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my grandparents ① sat as a couple at a table that had eleven chairs around it, and my mother said the sitting was the whole of the evening. The ② couple, meaning the two of them and not the table, said almost nothing and stayed that quiet; couple, she said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how little needs saying.

Every ③ couple at that wedding had the same dance, and the ④ couple at the end, meaning the one nobody had introduced and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described twice. Couple, my aunt said, is nine parts dance and one part somebody willing to be seen; my mother said the being seen is the part that fills the evening.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ a couple of chairs was the whole of the problem, meaning two or three and not the pair. The ⑥ couple, meaning the two or three and not any of that, is the only thing in a problem that everybody rounds down and nobody counts; couple, he said, is either something you sit as or the only word that means both a pair and two or three. She said the two or three is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ couple had become a line in a seating plan, and the plan had become an argument about the dance. The ⑧ couple of the whole thing, my mother wrote in June, was one table and thirty years of being seen; couple, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to say nothing. He said the saying nothing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ couple I remember is the one at the end, which sat down in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ couple, my aunt said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being described; every couple, she said, is a two or three that has agreed to look like a pair. She said the two or three was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 一对；夫妇；情侣
B. n. 夫妇（指他们俩本身，与那张桌子相对）
C. 固定搭配：sit as a couple 作为一对（夫妇）坐在一起
D. n. 一对（指那场婚礼上每一对）
E. n. 一对（指末尾那一对）
F. n. 两三个；几个（a couple of 表示约数）
G. n. 一对（指座位表上提到的那一对）
H. n. 一对；搭档（抽象总称）

items.q: sat as a couple at a table that had eleven chairs
The couple, meaning the two of them and not the table
a couple of chairs was the whole of the problem
The couple, meaning the two or three
the couple had become a line in a seating plan
The couple of the whole thing
A couple, my aunt said in 1972

answers.why: sit as a couple 意为“作为一对（夫妇）坐在一起”，1956 年祖父母作为夫妇坐在一张围着十一把椅子的桌旁。
couple 意为“夫妇、一对”，指他们俩本身而不是那张桌子，几乎什么也没说。
couple 指那场婚礼上每一对，每一对都跳同一支舞。
couple 指末尾那一对（没人介绍过的那一对），是唯一有人描述过两次的。
a couple of 意为“两三个、几个”，父亲说两三把椅子就是那个难题的全部，指的是约数而不是那一对。
couple 为数量用法，指两三个而不是那一对，是难题里人人都往少了算、却无人去数的东西。
couple 意为“一对”，指座位表上提到的那一对，到 1964 年这一对成了座位表里的一行。
couple 意为“一对、搭档”，母亲六月写道，整件事的一对是一张桌子三十年的被人看见。
couple 意为“夫妇、一对”，我记得的是末尾那一对，1970 年坐下，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
couple 为抽象总称，姑姑说一对夫妇是唯一会因为被描述而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年祖父母作为夫妇坐在一张围着十一把椅子的桌旁，母亲说坐在一起才是那个傍晚的全部。（sit as a couple）
那一对夫妇，指的是他们俩本身而不是那张桌子，几乎什么也没说，并且一直是那么安静。（couple）
那场婚礼上每一对都跳同一支舞。（couple）
末尾那一对，指的是没人介绍过的那一对，是唯一有人描述过两次的。（couple）
父亲说两三把椅子就是那个难题的全部，指的是约数而不是那一对。（a couple of）
1972 年姑姑说，一对夫妇是唯一会因为被描述而变好的东西。（couple）
answers: In 1956 my grandparents sat as a couple at a table that had eleven chairs around it, and my mother said the sitting was the whole of the evening.
The couple, meaning the two of them and not the table, said almost nothing and stayed that quiet.
Every couple at that wedding had the same dance.
The couple at the end, meaning the one nobody had introduced and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described twice.
My father said a couple of chairs was the whole of the problem, meaning two or three and not the pair.
A couple, my aunt said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being described.
